verdict.rationale: Official documentation in the google-gemini GitHub org confirms a first-party Gemini CLI, configurable through `~/.gemini/settings.json` and extensible with MCP servers. A community user reports a hands-on limitation: Workspace accounts fail to log in, so some paying users cannot use the CLI for work. missing for 10: install/auth and core command documentation (the available docs cover only MCP configuration), CLI support for Workspace accounts, and independent hands-on corroboration of everyday agentic CLI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: This document provides a guide to configuring and using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with Gemini CLI.
Configure MCP servers in `~/.gemini/settings.json` to extend Gemini CLI
